1\n\tcase monsterCount == 2:\n\t\tmultiplier = 1.5\n\tcase monsterCount >= 3 && monsterCount <= 6:\n\t\tmultiplier = 2\n\tcase monsterCount >= 7 && monsterCount <= 10:\n\t\tmultiplier = 2.5\n\tcase monsterCount >= 11 && monsterCount <= 14:\n\t\tmultiplier = 3\n\tcase monsterCount >= 15:\n\t\tmultiplier = 4\n\tdefault:\n\t\tmultiplier = 1\n\t}\n\n\tadjustedXP := float64(baseXP) * multiplier\n\n\ttotals := thresholds{}\n\tfor _, p := range req.Party {\n\t\tt, ok := levelThresholds[p.Level]\n\t\tif !ok {\n\t\t\tbadRequest(w, fmt.Sprintf(\"unsupported party level: %d\", := \"trivial\"\n\tif adjusted >= totals.deadly {\n\t\tdifficulty = \"deadly\"\n\t} else if adjusted >= totals.hard {\n\t\tdifficulty = \"hard\"\n\t} else if adjusted >= totals.medium {\n\t\tdifficulty = \"medium\"\n\t} else if adjusted >= totals.easy {\n\t\tdifficulty = \"easy\"\n\t}\n\n\twriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{\n\t\t\"base_xp\":       baseXP,\n\t\t\"monster_count\": totals.easy,\n\t\t\t\"medium\": totals.medium,\n\t\t\t\"hard\":   totals.hard,\n\t\t\t\"deadly\": totals.deadly,\n\t\t},\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc initiativeOrderHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
